# Shaping Tomorrow Decision Intelligence

> Continuous, decision-grade intelligence programmes for senior teams who need to see what's changing, why it matters and when to act. Weekly Signal Scans, monthly Change Trackers, quarterly Decision Intelligence briefings and end-of-cycle Action Triggers, every claim traced to a dated, tier-classified source.

## How the work is checked
- [How we verify](https://decision-intel.shapingtomorrow.com/how-we-verify/): source tiers, quote checks and the frame-fidelity gate
- [Track record](https://decision-intel.shapingtomorrow.com/track-record/): every dated call, graded in public
- [Feed](https://decision-intel.shapingtomorrow.com/feed.xml): the latest Signal Scans as RSS
